techParks.name: World Trade Center Bengaluru (Brigade Gateway)
techParks.description: The 128 m, 32-storey World Trade Center Bengaluru (completed 2010, WTCA-licensed, ~1.1 million sq ft with 40,000 sq ft floor plates) anchors Brigade Gateway, Brigade Group's 40-acre mixed-use enclave on Dr Rajkumar Road with Orion Mall, Sheraton Grand, Manipal Hospital, Brigade School and 1,200+ flats. The low-rise WTC Annexe (over 1 lakh sq ft, home to Brigade's BuzzWorks managed offices since March 2024) stands beside it. Amazon India has held ~18 floors since opening but announced in Nov 2024 a move to a Sattva site near the airport.

techParks.name: Rajajinagar IT Park
techParks.description: A small Karnataka State Small Industries Development Corporation IT/BT park inside the Rajajinagar Industrial Estate on Chord Road; ABB India's Bengaluru engineering office (Plot 1-4, 18th A Main) is its known anchor. Mapped as a commercial landuse in OSM (way 781588921).

techParks.name: Rajajinagar Industrial Estate
techParks.description: 1950s-era state industrial estate along Chord Road in Rajajinagar, now a mix of small engineering units, the Government Tool Room and Training Centre, and the KSSIDC IT park where ABB sits (OSM way 58516968).

techParks.name: Peenya Industrial Area
techParks.description: One of Asia's largest industrial areas, laid out from the late 1970s on the Tumkur Road (NH-4) in north-west Bengaluru: about 1,461 acres in four phases hosting some 13,000 MSMEs in machine tools, electrical goods, die-casting, hydraulics and textiles, notified as a Special Investment Region in 2025. Anchors include ABB's campus, Kirloskar Electric's corporate office, Ace Designers, Wipro's hydraulics works and ISRO's ISTRAC mission-control centre.

techParks.name: Brigade Rubix
techParks.description: Brigade Group's 2-basement + ground + 11-floor office building on HMT Link Road near the HMT township, with 14,000 sq ft typical floor plates, marketed to firms wanting to be near Wipro and ABB in Peenya; tenants not published.

techParks.name: Brigade Twin Towers
techParks.description: Twin office towers by Brigade on the Tumkur Road / Outer Ring Road junction at Goraguntepalya, opposite the under-construction RNS Business Park; mapped in OSM (way 133883061). No tenant list was found.

techParks.name: BEL Bengaluru Complex (Jalahalli)
techParks.description: BEL's original 1954 manufacturing township at Jalahalli East: the Bengaluru Complex factories, Central Research Laboratory, Product Development & Innovation Centre, BEL Academy for Excellence, BEL Hospital and the BEL-Thales Systems joint venture, next to the HMT Jalahalli campus.

coverageNotes: WEB-SEARCH BUDGET: the shared WebSearch quota ran out after my first ~6 queries, so everything after that was built from direct fetches of company, ISRO, Brigade and Wikipedia pages plus the OSM extracts and Nominatim/Photon geocoding; several company sites (ABB, BEL, BFW, Jindal Aluminium, CMTI, Toyota Tsusho, KPMG, Siemens, Aptean) returned 404/503 or were rate-limited, so those offices carry medium/low confidence and say so. WTC BENGALURU TENANTS: confirmed Amazon (18 floors, moving out 2025-26), Brigade Enterprises HQ (floors 29-30) and Regus; Toyota Tsusho only from an OSM POI; Siemens and KPMG only from a 2011 lease report. The brief's other guesses are WRONG for WTC on the evidence found: Sabre's Bengaluru office is at ITPB Whitefield (sabre.com), Kyndryl's are RMZ Titanium and Manyata (kyndryl.com), Rakuten/Publicis Sapient/Deloitte/Huawei/Shell appear in OSM only at Bagmane, Bellandur, Palace Road, Whitefield and Ecoworld respectively, and ABB's offices are Rajajinagar and Peenya; none was placed at WTC, so none is listed there. LEFT OUT: HMT Watches Jalahalli (closed 2016, before the 2023 cutoff) and Mysore Lamps Malleswaram (closed decades ago); BHEL's Malleswaram site (OSM polygon exists but bhel.com now lists only EDN/ESD/SBD at Mysore Road for Bengaluru, so the Electro Porcelain Division's status could not be confirmed); Bosch at Jalahalli (no evidence of any Bosch site there; Bosch's Bengaluru campuses are Adugodi, Bellandur, Naganathapura and Koramangala); 'Bengaluru Signature' could not be identified (OSM has only Vaishnavi Signature in Bellandur and Brigade Signature Towers in Whitefield); Mantri Square and Orion Mall are retail with no corporate tenants found; Honda Motorcycle south regional office, SICK India, Belden, ProMinent, LabCorp, Kardex Remstar, Nash Industries, Avery Dennison and John Crane are all mentioned by OSM, Wikipedia's Peenya list or a property listing for this belt but could not be substantiated to a building, so they are omitted; BEL-Thales Systems is noted under the BEL park rather than as a company. CROSS-CHECKS the brief asked for: BEML's HQ is BEML Soudha in Sampangiramanagar (central) and its rail complex at New Thippasandra (east); ITI's HQ is Dooravani Nagar (east); NAL is Kodihalli/Belur (east); every DRDO lab named (ADE, LRDE, GTRE, CAIR, CABS) plus ADA is in east Bengaluru -- all included for the merge but flagged as outside the north-west. ISRO HQ coordinates come from an OSM polygon oddly labelled 'Vijinapura Campus' that sits on New BEL Road exactly where Antariksh Bhavan is. COORDINATES: ABB Peenya and Kirloskar Electric use the Peenya Industrial Area centroid (plots did not geocode); Himalaya uses the Makali village node; IKEA uses the Nagasandra locality node; LRDE uses the shared DRDO Complex polygon; all are marked in geocodeSource. Headcounts per Bengaluru site were not stated by any source, so bengaluruEmployeesApprox is null throughout. STARTUPS: the north-west is an industrial belt, and only two venture-backed startups could be substantiated (Cloudphysician on Bellary Road, Ati Motors at Goraguntepalya); Satyukt Analytics and Belaku Innovations appear in OSM near Sanjaynagar/Malleswaram but are too small and unverified to list.
